summary: Initializes a D3D PSGP function-pointer table. With Data non-zero, copies a template table from off_5D78B0 into off_5D77C8, initializes it via FunctionTableInit, reads the "DisableD3DXPSGP" registry override, and otherwise patches the table for the best detected CPU feature (SSE2/SSE/3DNow!), recording the selected variant in dword_5D7998. With Data zero, resets dword_5D7998 to 0xFFFF (uninitialized) and restores the template copy. Returns dword_5D7998.

operations.description: If Data is non-zero, run the CPU-feature-dependent table initialization; otherwise take the reset branch.
Set dword_5D7998 = 0 as the in-progress initialization state marker.
Copy the template function table from off_5D78B0 into off_5D77C8 (0xE4 bytes).
Initialize the copied table with FunctionTableInit(&off_5D77C8).
Read the DisableD3DXPSGP registry override via sub_50FBFC(4, aDisabled3dxpsg, &Data, 4); on failure Data is forced to 0.
If Data != 1 (override not forcing the disabled state), detect the CPU feature and patch the table for it.
If OSVersionDetection(7) succeeds, patch the table with sub_5172A5(&off_5D77C8) and set dword_5D7998 = 1.
Else if OSVersionDetection(0xA) succeeds, patch the table with sub_5170C0(&off_5D77C8) and set dword_5D7998 = 2.
Else if OSVersionDetection(6) succeeds, patch the table with UnidentifiedLogicFunctionTable(&off_5D77C8) and set dword_5D7998 = 3.
Reset branch: set dword_5D7998 = 0xFFFF (uninitialized marker) and restore the template copy off_5D78B0 into off_5D77C8.
Return dword_5D7998 as the current table state.

unresolved: The mapping of OSVersionDetection codes 7, 0xA and 6 to specific CPU features (SSE2/SSE/3DNow!) is taken from existing_analysis prose and is not grounded in the packet.
The Data parameter is reused as an output buffer for the registry read, so its post-call value is not the original caller argument.
The identity of the function table stored at off_5D77C8 and the meaning of each variant state 1/2/3 are not evidenced in the packet.
